stem.text: The diagram shows three reactions of ethanal. In each case, an excess of ethanal is used.

stem.alt: Reaction scheme with ethanal, CH3CHO, at the centre and three arrows leaving it. Left, horizontal arrow labelled 'acidified K2Cr2O7' and 'heat' to solution 1. Up, vertical arrow labelled 'alkaline I2(aq)' and 'heat' to solid 2. Right, horizontal arrow labelled 'Fehling's solution' and 'boil' to solid 3.

stem.text: Observations are made after each of the three reactions.
What are the colours of solution 1 and solids 2 and 3?
